newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WEEK AHEAD - Australian markets focus on jobs.
newsitem.headline: WEEK AHEAD - Australian markets focus on jobs.

text.p: Thursday's employment data is the focus for financial markets this week after a busy two-week period of data which did little to clear up confusion about where the economy is heading.
Another highlight will be a speech by Reserve Bank Governor Ian Macfarlane who will be talking to the Sydney Institute on Tuesday evening on "the economics of nostalgia."

Employment was one of the weakest areas of the economy through 1996 but was showing some signs of improvement in the final quarter. Most economists expect January's unemployment level to remain at December's 8.6 percent figure.
